ABBREVIATIONS
JMSDF: Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force
PLAN: People’s Liberation Army Navy (China)
AGI: Auxiliary General Intelligence

-The PLAN AGI continued to sail northeastward through the waters between Amami-Oshima Island and Yokoate-jima Island into the Pacific Ocean.
-JMSDF assets monitored the activities of the vessel.

The activity of a Chinese Navy vessel in the waters surrounding Japan.
-At around 4:00 a.m., Sunday, September 13, 2026, JMSDF spotted PLAN Dongdiao-class AGI x 1 (hull number 799) sailing southeastward in the waters approximately 70 km west of Amami-Oshima Island. https://t.co/L
